title: 2022年6月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
paperTitle: 2022年6月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
prompt: Suppose you are going to write a proposal to your student union for enriching students’ extracurricular activities. You are to write about what activities to organize and why. You will have 30 minutes to write the proposal. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
reference: A Proposal on Enriching Extracurricular Activities I am writing to propose a few extracurricular activities that our student union could organize, in the hope of making our campus life more colorful and rewarding. To begin with, I would suggest holding a monthly book-sharing club. Since many of us read alone and seldom exchange thoughts, such a club would offer a regular chance to share insights, broaden our horizons and improve our critical thinking. In addition, I recommend arranging weekend volunteer trips to nearby communities. These activities would not only allow us to apply what we learn in real life, but also cultivate a stronger sense of social responsibility and teamwork among students. I sincerely hope the student union will take these suggestions into consideration. Your support would mean a great deal to all of us. Thank you for your time and attention.
keyPoints: 标题＋目的句。首行用标题 A Proposal on Enriching Extracurricular Activities 点题，正文 以 I am writing to propose... 落实'开门见山提目的'，一句话交代来意与大方向。
建议一配理由。To begin with, I would suggest holding a monthly book-sharing club 抛 出活动，Since many of us read alone... would offer a regular chance to share insights 紧跟理由， 落实'主张＋理由'两步。
建议二双重益处。In addition, I recommend arranging weekend volunteer trips 追加第 二项，用 not only allow us to apply what we learn... but also cultivate a stronger sense of social responsibility 把'为什么办'说得立体。
呼吁并致谢。I sincerely hope the student union will take these suggestions into consideration 请求采纳，末句 Thank you for your time and attention 致谢收束，稳住 proposal 的 语气。
